question: CAP-U10QUOTEPW-PREDICT

what.P: A Quote picked to the Quote list's layout 0 (811.9 wide, padding 24.4 = 3% in CAP-U10QUOTEH.json), then its right handle dragged 470px left, about 8 columns, to about 341.7 wide.
what.N: A new Quote (341.7 wide, padding 20.5 = 6% in CAP-U10QUOTEH.json), then its right handle dragged 470px right, about 8 columns, to about 811.9 wide.

rules.pick: The pick sets 3% and it stays on the block through a resize: P 3% of its new width, N 6% of its new width. Ours as built in PR 594 (b.quotePad).
rules.width: The width sets it, 3% at 459.3 and wider, 6% at 341.7 and narrower: P 6%, N 3%.

scoring: Padding = .sqs-block-content left minus the block's left, over the block's width, within 0.2 percentage points; runs A and B must agree.
